name: Gossamer
desc: Ballooning spider silk adrift on the air — long filaments undulate through the frame in parallax depth, each catching a travelling specular sheen exactly where its length turns broadside to the light, trailing ends kinking into slow curls; sits over any scene as a barely-there veil of thread.

energy.doc: undulation amplitude, strand length and overall brightness

density.doc: how many filaments are in the air

curl.doc: how hard the trailing ends kink and curl up

glint.doc: specular sheen where a strand runs perpendicular to the light

x.doc: light-source x — the sheen tracks it

y.doc: light-source y — the sheen tracks it

alpha.doc: master opacity over the scene below
